id: 08_Star Delta Connection Verification of Line and Phase Quantities Basic Electrical
title: 三相星形与三角形连接实验
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/08_Star Delta Connection Verification of Line and Phase Quantities Basic Electrical.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/08_Star Delta Connection Verification of Line and Phase Quantities Basic Electrical/src.py

points.K9: 相电压：一线与中性点之间
points.K10: 星形：线电流等于相电流
points.K13: 先断开、先回零，再合闸升压
points.K16: 三角形：首尾相连成闭环
points.K17: 三角形的用途（原片说法）
points.K19: 测相电流，线电压即相电压
points.K20: 三相电，安全措施要做足
points.K21: 三角形只升到较低电压
points.S2: 接法要和负载额定电压相配
points.S6: 触电一时断不了电怎么办

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上三盏灯泡、一台高大的三相调压器、几只电表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with three light bulbs on a board, a tall three-phase variable autotransformer and several analog meters, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课做三相星形和三角形连接实验。
overlay: 三相星形与三角形连接实验

shots.scene: 星形和三角形两个连接图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: three loads joined at a center point in a star shape, and three loads joined end to end in a triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 看看线电压、相电压，线电流、相电流。

shots.scene: 阿杰做完星形实验，直接把灯改成三角形，手伸向调压器旋钮，旋钮仍在高位
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has rewired the three lamps into a triangle and reaches for the autotransformer, whose knob is still turned high.
shots.narration: 阿杰改成三角形，想直接用刚才的电压。

shots.scene: 灯泡过亮、冒出闪光的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an over-bright bulb with a burst flash, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这样灯泡会承受过高电压，可能烧坏炸裂。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着三相总开关和调压器旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to the three-phase main switch and the autotransformer knob.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先断电回零，再算电压。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 三相实验，每一步都要想清楚。

shots.scene: 一本空白理论书和一块实验板用箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: A blank textbook and a three-lamp experiment board linked by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 目的：在实验室验证星形三角形的关系。

shots.scene: 三个线圈的末端连在同一点
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of three coils whose ending terminals are all joined at one center point. No people.
shots.narration: 星形：三个线圈的同名端接在一起。

shots.scene: 中心点被圈出并发光
shots.prompt_en: The center joining point of the star diagram circled and glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 这一点叫中性点，也叫星点。

shots.scene: 星形图标旁，电压箭头长、电流箭头短
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon with a long voltage arrow and a short current arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说：星形多用在高电压、小电流的场合。

shots.scene: 透明板上三盏灯，每盏灯两端标首端和末端
shots.prompt_en: Three bulbs on a transparent board, each with two terminals marked by small start and end tags. No people.
shots.narration: 用三盏灯代表三相负载。

shots.scene: 三盏灯的末端用导线连在一起
shots.prompt_en: The ending terminals of the three bulbs joined together by short leads. No people.
shots.narration: 三个末端连起来，就是星点。

shots.scene: 墙上配电箱：三极开关和三相插座，三根线引出
shots.prompt_en: A wall distribution box with a three-pole breaker and a three-phase industrial socket, three wires leading out. No people.
shots.narration: 三相电源经熔断器和三极开关引出。

shots.scene: 高大的三相调压器，正面输入、输出两组端子，顶部旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A tall three-phase variable autotransformer with an input terminal group and an output terminal group on the front and a large knob on top. No people.
shots.narration: 电源接三相调压器的输入端。

shots.scene: 旋钮转动，三根输出电压条一起从零上升
shots.prompt_en: The knob turning and three output voltage bars rising together from zero. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器能让三相电压从零平滑调高。

shots.scene: 电路图：调压器输出 1 经电流表接 A1
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: output one of the autotransformer goes through an ammeter to terminal A1. No people.
shots.narration: 输出一经电流表接 A1。

shots.scene: 输出 2、3 分别接 B1、C1，A2、B2、C2 连成星点
shots.prompt_en: The diagram continues: outputs two and three go to B1 and C1, and A2, B2, C2 are joined at the star point. No people.
shots.narration: 输出二接 B1，输出三接 C1。

shots.scene: 一只电压表跨在两根线之间
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter connected between two of the three line wires in the diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 线电压：任意两根线之间的电压。

shots.section_title: 相电压：一线与中性点之间
shots.scene: 另一只电压表接在一根线和星点之间
shots.prompt_en: A second voltmeter connected between one line wire and the star point. No people.
shots.narration: 相电压：一根线和中性点之间的电压。
overlay: 相电压：一线与中性点之间

shots.section_title: 星形：线电流等于相电流
shots.scene: 星形中一根线上的电流箭头直接流进一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A star diagram where the current arrow in one line flows straight into one lamp with no branch. No people.
shots.narration: 星形里，线电流就是相电流。
overlay: 星形：线电流等于相电流

shots.section_title: 星形：线电流等于相电流
shots.scene: 只有一只电流表打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A single ammeter icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所以只用一只电流表就够了。

shots.scene: 小研在空白报告纸上画电路图并标注
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws a neat circuit diagram on a blank report sheet and adds small rating tags.
shots.narration: 考试时电路图要画清楚，标明额定值。

shots.scene: 镜头扫过调压器、配电箱、三盏灯和三只表
shots.prompt_en: A panning view over the three-phase autotransformer, the wall distribution box, the three bulbs and three analog meters. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器、三极开关、三盏灯、三只表。

shots.scene: 两只电压表一只电流表并排，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: Two voltmeters and one ammeter side by side with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 一只测线电压，一只测相电压，一只测电流。

shots.section_title: 先断开、先回零，再合闸升压
shots.scene: 三极开关在断开位置，调压器旋钮在零位，各打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Two close-ups with green checks: the three-pole breaker in the off position and the autotransformer knob at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 接线时：开关断开，调压器在最小位置。
overlay: 先断开、先回零，再合闸升压

shots.section_title: 先断开、先回零，再合闸升压
shots.scene: 老周合上三极开关
shots.prompt_en: The older man switches on the three-pole breaker in the distribution box.
shots.narration: 接好线、查过线，再合闸。

shots.section_title: 先断开、先回零，再合闸升压
shots.scene: 老周盯着电压表慢慢转动调压器旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The older man watches the voltmeter while slowly turning the autotransformer knob.
shots.narration: 看着电压表，慢慢升到所需线电压。

shots.scene: 电压表接线柱被圈出，箭头指向上刻度
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter's connected terminal circled, an arrow pointing to the upper scale. No people.
shots.narration: 按所接量程，读上刻度或下刻度。

shots.scene: 三盏灯亮起，小研在空白表格上记录
shots.prompt_en: The three bulbs glow while the female graduate student records readings in a blank table.
shots.narration: 记下线电压、相电压和线电流。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮转回零，再拉下三极开关
shots.prompt_en: An icon sequence: the autotransformer knob turned back to zero, then the three-pole breaker switched off. No people.
shots.narration: 读完先把调压器调回零，再断闸。

shots.section_title: 三角形：首尾相连成闭环
shots.scene: 三个线圈首尾相连成三角形
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of three coils where the end of each coil joins the start of the next, forming a closed triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形：一相末端接下一相首端。
overlay: 三角形：首尾相连成闭环

shots.section_title: 三角形：首尾相连成闭环
shots.scene: 沿三角形画出一个闭合的箭头环
shots.prompt_en: A closed loop arrow traced around the triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 三相首尾相连，形成闭合回路。

shots.section_title: 三角形的用途（原片说法）
shots.scene: 三角形图标旁，电流箭头长、电压箭头短
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon with a long current arrow and a short voltage arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说：三角形多用在大电流、低电压的场合。
overlay: 三角形的用途（原片说法）

shots.scene: 电路图：调压器三路输出经电流表分别接 A1、B1、C1
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the three autotransformer outputs go to A1, B1 and C1, the first through an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器三路输出，分别接三个首端。

shots.scene: A2 接 B1、B2 接 C1、C2 接 A1 的连线依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The links A2 to B1, B2 to C1 and C2 to A1 light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 末端接下一相首端，连成三角形。

shots.section_title: 测相电流，线电压即相电压
shots.scene: 第二只电流表串在一相负载里
shots.prompt_en: A second ammeter placed inside one side of the triangle, in series with one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 另一只电流表串在一相里，测相电流。
overlay: 测相电流，线电压即相电压

shots.section_title: 测相电流，线电压即相电压
shots.scene: 电压表跨在一盏灯两端，同时也跨在两根线之间
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter across one lamp, which is also across two line wires. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形里，线电压就是相电压。

shots.section_title: 三相电，安全措施要做足
shots.scene: 王老师指着三相配电箱，旁边警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the three-phase distribution box next to an electrical hazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 三相电，安全措施一定要做足。
overlay: 三相电，安全措施要做足

shots.section_title: 三相电，安全措施要做足
shots.scene: 老李逐个按紧接线柱，检查导线插牢
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses each terminal and checks that every lead is firmly plugged in.
shots.narration: 严格按图接线，接头要牢固。

shots.section_title: 三角形只升到较低电压
shots.scene: 老周慢慢转动调压器，电压表指针停在较低位置
shots.prompt_en: The older man slowly turns the autotransformer knob and the voltmeter needle stops at a low position.
shots.narration: 三角形时，只把电压升到较低的值。
overlay: 三角形只升到较低电压

shots.scene: 两只电流表读数不同
shots.prompt_en: Two ammeters side by side showing different needle positions. No people.
shots.narration: 线电流和相电流，读数不一样。

shots.scene: 调压器回零，开关断开，小研记录
shots.prompt_en: The autotransformer knob back at zero and the breaker off, while the female graduate student writes in a blank table.
shots.narration: 读完回零断闸，把数据填进表。

shots.scene: 星形卡片：线电流等于相电流，线电压是相电压的根号三倍
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a star icon and two relation icons: equal currents, and voltage with a square root of three. No people.
shots.narration: 星形：电流相等，线电压是相电压的√3倍。

shots.scene: 三角形卡片：线电压等于相电压，线电流是相电流的根号三倍
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a triangle icon and two relation icons: equal voltages, and current with a square root of three. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形：电压相等，线电流是相电流的√3倍。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着两张卡片若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies the two cards thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 想一想：什么时候用星形，什么时候用三角形？

shots.scene: 单相插座和三相插座并排，三相那边的闪电符号更大
shots.prompt_en: A single-phase socket and a three-phase industrial socket side by side, the three-phase one with a bigger lightning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 三相线电压比单相高得多。

shots.scene: 两根相线之间的人形图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram touching two line wires at once, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦触电，后果更严重。

shots.scene: 王老师在三相实验台前挂上警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hangs an electrical hazard warning sign on the three-phase lab bench.
shots.narration: 三相实验，按准入要求、在老师指导下做。

shots.section_title: 接法要和负载额定电压相配
shots.scene: 灯泡铭牌和电压表指针对比，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A bulb's blank rating label next to a voltmeter needle at a matching mark, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 负载两端的电压，不能超过它的额定值。
overlay: 接法要和负载额定电压相配

shots.section_title: 接法要和负载额定电压相配
shots.scene: 星形时每盏灯电压小，三角形时每盏灯直接接线电压
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams: in the star, each lamp has a short voltage arrow; in the triangle, each lamp has a long voltage arrow equal to the line voltage. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形时，每盏灯直接承受线电压。

shots.section_title: 接法要和负载额定电压相配
shots.scene: 三角形接法下电压没降、灯泡炸裂的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a triangle-connected lamp with a too-long voltage arrow and a bursting bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 改三角形不降压，灯泡会烧坏甚至炸裂。

shots.section_title: 接法要和负载额定电压相配
shots.scene: 王老师和小研对着空白计算纸核对电压
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student check the planned voltage on a blank calculation sheet.
shots.narration: 通电前先算好电压，请老师确认。

shots.scene: 老周把调压器回零，再拉下三相开关
shots.prompt_en: The older man turns the autotransformer to zero, then switches off the three-pole breaker.
shots.narration: 改接前：调压器回零，断开三相开关。

shots.scene: 老李用验电器逐一检测三个输出端，指示灯不亮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks each of the three output terminals with a voltage tester; its indicator stays dark.
shots.narration: 用合格的验电器确认确实无电。

shots.scene: 阿杰改接三角形，王老师检查后点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rewires the lamps into a triangle; the safety administrator checks the board and nods.
shots.narration: 改完请老师检查，同意后再合闸。

shots.scene: 三根相线、中性线、保护线各用不同颜色
shots.prompt_en: Five conductors in a row, each a different color: yellow, green, red, light blue, and green-yellow striped. No people.
shots.narration: 国内三相导线，按颜色区分相线。

shots.scene: 导线两端套着空白标签，对应调压器端子
shots.prompt_en: Leads with blank tags on both ends matched to the autotransformer terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 接线做好标识，不靠记忆乱接。

shots.scene: 黄绿双色线只接保护接地端，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A green-yellow striped wire connected only to an earth terminal, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 黄绿双色线只作保护接地，不能挪作他用。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰两人一组做实验，王老师在旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work as a pair at the three-phase bench while the safety administrator stands nearby.
shots.narration: 强电实验至少两人，老师在场。

shots.scene: 一人操作，一人站在总开关旁监护
shots.prompt_en: The young male student operates the knob while the female graduate student stands beside the main breaker watching him.
shots.narration: 一人操作，一人守在总开关旁监护。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在三相台前的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lone person working at a three-phase bench with no one else in the room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能一个人单独做强电实验。

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 阿杰触电，小研冲向总开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is caught by an electric shock at the bench; the female graduate student rushes to the main breaker.
shots.narration: 有人触电，首先断开总开关。
overlay: 触电一时断不了电怎么办

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 老周用干燥木棍挑开导线
shots.prompt_en: The older man uses a dry wooden stick to push a wire away from the young male student, standing on a dry board.
shots.narration: 一时断不了电，用干燥木棍等绝缘物挑开导线。

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 徒手拉人的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a person being shocked, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能徒手去拉触电的人。

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 调压器冒烟，老李断闸后用二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Smoke rises from the autotransformer; the facility engineer switches off the breaker and uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 电气起火先断电，火大撤离打 119。

shots.section_title: 触电一时断不了电怎么办
shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 星形和三角形两张结论卡
shots.prompt_en: The star result card and the triangle result card side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 星形电流相等，三角形电压相等。

shots.scene: 开关断开、旋钮归零、慢慢升压、先回零再断闸四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in order: breaker off, knob at zero, slow voltage rise, knob back to zero then breaker off. No people.
shots.narration: 断开回零再合闸，慢升压，先回零再断闸。

shots.scene: 负载额定电压、验电器、颜色导线三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a lamp rating label, a voltage tester, and color-coded wires. No people.
shots.narration: 电压配额定，改接先验电，颜色要分清。

shots.scene: 两人监护、木棍、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: two people at a bench, a dry wooden stick, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 有人监护，触电先断电，断不了用绝缘物。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在断电、旋钮归零的三相实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the three-phase bench with the breaker off and the autotransformer knob at zero.
shots.narration: 三相不马虎，安全每一步，下次见！
